title: ValueHelpDialog
description: Fiori value help dialog (composite after the Fiori design guidelines): Search and Select with filters and a result table, Define Conditions, selected items and conditions as tokens, single/multi selection.

usage.summary: Find business values through a searchable result table or define filter conditions in a dialog.
useWhen: Search business keys and descriptions across columns; identify returned keys with keyField and optional descriptionField.
Select several values with selectionMode="multiple", or confirm one row immediately with selectionMode="single".
Define operators and ranges with supportConditions in multiple mode; disable it for selection-only tasks.
Supply filters for multiattribute search, or handle onSearch and pass updated items for server-side results.

avoidWhen.when: Pick one value from a short predefined list without inspecting additional attributes.
Choose one value from suggestions or accept free text without a separate search task.
Select several values from a manageable predefined list without conditions.
Enter several tokens without needing a search dialog.
